title: Scalable patterns onboarding storyboard and screenshot suite
creator: Maya Singh
description: Create a cohesive storyboard and screenshot suite that explains scalable capacity patterns for first-time Dedicated customers. This ticket covers: a 6-frame onboarding storyboard that visualizes capacity decisions (reserved vs burst), three responsive mockups (desktop, tablet, mobile) for the capacity setup flow, annotated screenshot variants for autoscaling rules and SLA overview, and a lightweight set of microcopy alternatives for error/fallback states. Deliverables should be ready for handoff to engineering and documentation teams and include assets optimized for the release notes and the in-app quickstart modal.
acceptance_criteria: 6-frame storyboard PNGs illustrating: baseline reserved capacity, burst behavior, autoscale ramp-up, policy fallback to lower-cost model, cross-region failover, and final SLA confirmation
Responsive mockups (desktop/tablet/mobile) for the capacity setup page showing progressive disclosure of autoscale settings
Annotated screenshots describing SLA tiers and trade-offs with clear microcopy for each tier
Accessible color and contrast checks passed for SLA badges and CTA buttons (WCAG AA) with documented color tokens
All source Figma files, export-ready PNG/JPG assets, and a one-page handoff doc with dev specs and copy variants
screenshots_needed: Capacity estimator with reserved vs burst toggle (desktop)
SLA overview card with latency/cost breakdown (mobile)
Failure/fallback state showing model variant downgrade and retry banner
tasks: Draft initial storyboard frames and rough sketches
Review storyboard with PM and Eng to validate scenarios
Add annotations and microcopy variants for each screenshot
Run accessibility contrast checks and adjust tokens
Export assets and produce the handoff spec PDF
Schedule design review and sign-off with PMs and engineering owners
